g.text: The three Kalash valleys shelter one of the smallest and oldest living cultures in South Asia, with its own language,
wooden shrines and seasonal festivals, set beneath the peaks of the Hindu Kush. Chitral town, with its fort and Shahi
What to see & do in Kalash
Distinct ancient heritage, hand-hewn cedar villages, traditional music, and breathtaking Hindu Kush panoramas.
Chilam Joshi spring festival and Uchal
Chitral Fort, Shahi Mosque & Tirich Mir
